propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the Appium test suite for the store-task application on the handheld fleet and added the offline-sync scenarios.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the scenario list document the suite.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran pilot-store test rounds with store staff in three pilot stores and recorded outcomes per scenario.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the results sheet document the pilot rounds.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was accountable for store release quality end-to-end and held the release sign-off.
propositions.rationale: The resume assigns scope decisions and the sign-off to the store systems manager; the cover-note wording and the referee's praise do not record an authority held.

expectedGap: The materials show suite maintenance, pilot rounds and readiness summaries; they do not show the candidate deciding scope or signing releases off.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the boundary the resume states: scope and sign-off by the store systems manager; the candidate tested and summarised.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate ever signed off a store release himself and which readiness decisions were his.

signatures: knew the app better than anyone
